notes.note: Parish did have 17 disposals but there were 6 clangers which didn't help and he finished with his second below 40 in a row.
Parish did have 15 touches but a 53% efficiency and 2 free kicks given away and 6 clangers meant he had his worst score of the season. Not what we wanted.
Parish came back into the side this week with 25 disposals. This was below his average and if you held then he is one you should be looking to upgrade.
Parish posted his equal lowest score of the season with this being the third 67 for him. Hopefully this is not a regression back to these scores regularly.

Parish was everywhere in the middle ending with 9 clearances and 16 contested possessions to go with 41 disposals and 7 marks. If not for 5 free kicks given away this score could have been even higher!
Parish was the top scoring Bomber with his 25 disposals at 84% resulting in his third 100+ score for the season.
Parish returned this week with 23 touches and a goal. He hit his BE but with some 100+ scores dropping out of his score cycle he is now over 100 for a BE so you should look at trading.
This was his lowest in the last four games with 15 of his 23 disposals being handballs. Hopefully this score isn't a sign of things to come.
Again Parish has delivered after he was traded out a couple of weeks ago by a lot of teams. 30 disposals 11 clearances and 15 contested possessions shows why many started with him.
Parish was hotly traded out this week and of course that led to a huge score and his best of the season from 34 disposals. Certainly not time to bring him in though.
Parish got to his BE but only just with 19 disposals. He can be traded whenever you are able as this looks to be his ceiling.
Back to back scores in the mid 60s for Parish. We expected more from him and with a new BE of 71 we may need to consider getting out this week.

Parish didn't have a big outing but did get his hands on the footy with 24 disposals it was just that only 66% were effective. The Bombers mids were under immense pressure but this is likely to be the case every week.
Parish returned with a bang in the first term but did slow down from there. He finished well with 21 disposals. In 46% of sides don't rush to move him on.
